final: SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appearances a2 JOIN player p2 ON a2.player_id = p2.player_id WHERE p2.bats IS NOT NULL AND p2.bats <> '') AS fraction, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM appearances a3 JOIN player p3 ON a3.player_id = p3.player_id WHERE p3.bats IS NOT NULL AND p3.bats <> '' GROUP BY p3.bats)) AS ratio_to_avg FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.bats
